nets: SW node (L2 / C18 / U4 junction, x≈580)
EPD charge-pump rail to J2.23 and C10
anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, U5 (SS2040FL) has its bar/cathode on pin 1, which sits on the switching node shared with L2's output, C18 and U4. Its anode (pin 2) goes to the rail feeding J2.23 and C10. Current would flow from the rail back into the switch node, the reverse of the boost output diode U10 (anode on the switch node, cathode to the output rail).
anomalies.expected: The boost-stage rectifier should conduct from the switch node to the output rail, as U10 does (anode on the SW node, cathode to C6/J2.21). Its orientation should match U10 unless it is a deliberate charge-pump polarity.

anomalies.impact: If the orientation is reversed, the boost output rail that feeds the panel's high-voltage pins cannot be charged correctly from the switch node, so the display driver would not work properly. The symbol orientation is hard to read at this resolution, so confidence is limited.
